identity.kind: gear reducer / gearbox (cast-body) for industrial drive

claims.claim: Gear reducer 15 to 20hp cast bodies types
claims.evidence: No readable nameplate/spec plate, rating plate, or model/ratio info in photos 0-2 to confirm 15–20hp suitability.
Photos 0-2 show no shipping marks, paperwork, or identifiable Belgium/Tokunbo indicators.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 cannot confirm internal condition, noise/knock, mileage, or whether it has been opened.

risks.risk: Unknown gear ratio/output speed and shaft details (critical for matching to the motor and application).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate/spec label showing model, ratio, input/output RPM, and shaft dimensions (or a close-up of any stamped markings).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used gear reducer with unknown ratio and compatibility risk.

risks.risk: Unconfirmed power rating (seller says 15–20hp; could be lower/higher than needed).
risks.proof: Nameplate photo showing rated input power and service factor (or manufacturer datasheet for the exact model).
risks.if_unproven: Priced conservatively as not confirmed for 15–20hp duty.

risks.risk: Internal wear/damage not visible (bearings/gears), despite 'no knock' claim.
risks.proof: Video of it running under load (or at least a start/idle run) plus a short sound recording; also photo of oil condition if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to be in perfect working condition (worst case: needs service).

risks.risk: Oil leak or seal failure (may not show in still photos).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seals/joints and a 24-hour standing check for fresh oil spots; or a running video showing no seepage.

risks.risk: Mounting compatibility (base pattern, shaft coupling type, and alignment).
risks.proof: Measure/photograph the bolt-hole pattern on the base and the shaft end/coupling type; include a ruler/measure in-frame.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may require adapter plates/coupling work.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the reducer nameplate/spec label (model, ratio, input/output RPM, mounting type, serial number).
Video of the reducer running (showing output rotation direction and any abnormal noise) and ideally under light load.
Photos of oil level/condition and any visible leaks around seals and joints.
Close-up measurements of mounting bolt pattern and output shaft/coupling dimensions.
response.reason: The photos show a cast-body industrial gear reducer, but the key pricing drivers (exact model/ratio/power rating and confirmed working condition) are not readable or verifiable from the images. Request the nameplate and a running proof before pricing confidently.
